description: This file defines an internal interface IDeploymentLoadPublisher within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, which extends ISystemTarget and includes a method for asynchronously updating runtime statistics for a silo.

classes.name: IDeploymentLoadPublisher
classes.description: An internal interface for publishing deployment load information, includes a method to update runtime statistics on a silo.

methods.name: UpdateRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Asynchronously updates runtime statistics for a specified silo.
